description: Single Supervisory Mechanism and banking supervision framework

requirements.requirement_text: The ECB and the competent authorities of Member States that are not participating Member States shall conclude a memorandum of understanding describing in general terms how they will cooperate with one another in the performance of their supervisory tasks under Union law in relation to the financial institutions referred to in this Regulation.
requirements.applicable_entity: ECB and competent authorities of non-participating Member States
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: The memorandum should be reviewed on a regular basis.
requirements.applicable_entity: ECB and competent authorities of non-participating Member States
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: The ECB should be able to exercise supervisory tasks in relation to all credit institutions authorised in, and branches established in, participating Member States.
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: When carrying out the tasks conferred on it, and without prejudice to the objective to ensure the safety and soundness of credit institutions, the ECB should have full regard to the diversity of credit institutions and their size and business models, as well as the systemic benefits of diversity in the banking industry of the Union.
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: The exercise of the ECB's tasks should contribute in particular to ensure that credit institutions fully internalise all costs caused by their activities so as to avoid moral hazard and the excessive risk taking arising from it.
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: It should take full account of the relevant macroeconomic conditions in Member States, in particular the stability of the supply of credit and facilitation of productive activities for the economy at large.
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: The ECB should therefore have the task of authorising credit institutions that are to be established in a participating Member State and should be respon
requirements.law_title: Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 of 15 October 2013 conferring specific tasks on the European Central Bank concerning policies relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions

requirements.requirement_text: When assessing the appropriateness of the risk weights referred to in Article 124(2), first subparagraph, of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013, the authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of that Regulation shall determine the loss experience as the ratio of losses to exposure value for exposures secured by mortgages on residential property and commercial immovable property
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: When assessing the appropriateness of the risk weights, the authorities shall determine the loss expectation as the best estimate of losses to be realised during a forward-looking horizon of at least one year, and, if so determined by that authority, up to three years
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.deadline_text: forward-looking horizon of at least one year, and up to three years
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The loss expectation shall be determined as the average of the estimated losses for each year during the chosen forward-looking horizon
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The authorities shall determine the loss expectation by adjusting the loss experience upwards or downwards, or by keeping the loss experience unchanged
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: When determining the loss expectation, the authorities shall reflect the forward-looking immovable property market developments during a forward-looking horizon of at least one year and, if so determined by that authority, up to three years
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.deadline_text: forward-looking horizon of at least one year and up to three years
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The loss expectation shall be based on all of the following: historical evolution and cyclical characteristics of the immovable property market, past and present structural characteristics, fundamental drivers of demand and supply, riskiness of exposures, expected evolution in prices and volatility, expected evolution in macroeconomic variables, time horizon, national specificities, and other relevant data indicators
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where there is a lot of uncertainty as to the factors referred to in paragraph 3, point (e), the authorities shall consider a margin of prudence when determining the loss expectation
requirements.applicable_entity: authorities designated in accordance with Article 124(1a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/206 of 5 October 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the types of factors to be considered for the assessment of the appropriateness of risk weights for exposures secured by immovable property and the conditions to be taken into account for the assessment of the appropriateness of minimum loss given default values for exposures secured by immovable property (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2020/1575 of the European Central Bank of 27 October 2020 as regards the assessment of and follow-up on information on breaches reported through the whistleblowing tool where a person concerned is a high-level ECB official (ECB/2020/54)

requirements.requirement_text: SSM electronic applications, systems, platforms and services with medium or above medium criticality shall only be accessed and used if a user has been authenticated by means of an electronic certificate issued and managed by a certification authority accepted in accordance with the ESCB/SSM certificate acceptance framework, including by the ESCB-PKI certification authority.
requirements.applicable_entity: users of SSM electronic applications, systems, platforms and services
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2016/188 of the European Central Bank of 11 December 2015 on the access and use of SSM electronic applications, systems, platforms and services by the European Central Bank and the national competent authorities of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (ECB/2015/47)

requirements.requirement_text: The ESCB-PKI certification authority shall issue electronic certificates and provide other certification services to the competent authorities participating in the ESCB-PKI pursuant to Article 3 for their certificate subscribers and for the certificate subscribers of third parties working with them to enable them to securely access and use SSM electronic applications, systems, platforms and services.
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2016/188 of the European Central Bank of 11 December 2015 on the access and use of SSM electronic applications, systems, platforms and services by the European Central Bank and the national competent authorities of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (ECB/2015/47)

requirements.requirement_text: The participating competent authority shall be subject to the obligations set out in Articles 6, 7 and 12 of Decision ECB/2013/1 and shall submit a declaration to the Governing Council by which it confirms its participation and compliance with the obligations laid down in the Level 2 — Level 3 Agreement referred to in Article 4(2) of that Decision.
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2016/188 of the European Central Bank of 11 December 2015 on the access and use of SSM electronic applications, systems, platforms and services by the European Central Bank and the national competent authorities of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (ECB/2015/47)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall assess the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach at all times, covering all requirements irrespective of their degree of materiality
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall apply the same criteria to all aspects of the assessment of compliance with the requirements to use the IRB Approach, including initial applications, additional applications, material changes, notifications, ongoing reviews, and applications for return to less sophisticated approaches
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall apply the same methods for assessment to ensure consistent assessment of compliance with IRB Approach requirements throughout the Union
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify compliance with the minimum criteria specified in this Regulation and any other relevant criteria necessary for assessing IRB Approach compliance
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: In subsequent requests for permission based on approved sequential implementation plans, competent authorities shall base their assessment at least on the rules on use and experience test, assignment to grades or pools, rating systems and risk quantification
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where an institution has delegated tasks, activities or functions relating to rating systems to a third party or obtained rating systems from a third party vendor, competent authorities shall verify that all rating systems and related processes are assessed, adequate controls are implemented, full documentation is available, and the institution has sufficient in-house understanding
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify the appropriateness of the time limit for implementation of the roll-out plan, compliance with deadlines, and the necessity of changes to the roll-out plan
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify that all exposures covered by the roll-out plan have a defined and reasonable maximum timeframe for implementation of the IRB Approach
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify the robustness of the validation function, including independence from credit risk control unit, completeness, frequency and adequacy of methods and procedures, and soundness of the reporting process
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify that validation of performance of rating systems covering material portfolios and back-testing of all other rating systems is performed at least annually
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify that all areas of the IRB Approach are effectively covered by internal audits and that annual reviews are performed to determine areas requiring more thorough reviews
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall verify that rating systems are incorporated in the relevant processes of the institution within the broader processes of risk management, credit approval and decision-making process as part of the use test
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/439 of 20 October 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards for the specification of the assessment methodology competent authorities are to follow when assessing the compliance of credit institutions and investment firms with the requirements to use the Internal Ratings Based Approach (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Members of the management body of a significant supervised entity must fulfil fit and proper requirements at all times in accordance with Article 91 of Directive 2013/36/EU and any other applicable law
requirements.applicable_entity: members of management bodies of significant supervised entities
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2017/935 of the European Central Bank of 16 November 2016 on delegation of the power to adopt fit and proper decisions and the assessment of fit and proper requirements (ECB/2016/42)

requirements.requirement_text: The Governing Council delegates the power to adopt fit and proper decisions to the heads of work units nominated by the Executive Board in accordance with Article 5 of Decision (EU) 2017/933 (ECB/2016/40)
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2017/935 of the European Central Bank of 16 November 2016 on delegation of the power to adopt fit and proper decisions and the assessment of fit and proper requirements (ECB/2016/42)

requirements.requirement_text: The heads of work units shall adopt delegated decisions in accordance with this Decision and applicable law
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2017/935 of the European Central Bank of 16 November 2016 on delegation of the power to adopt fit and proper decisions and the assessment of fit and proper requirements (ECB/2016/42)

requirements.requirement_text: A fit and proper decision shall not be adopted by means of a delegated decision if the relevant supervised entity is the supervised entity at the highest level of consolidation within the participating Member States of a significant supervised group

requirements.requirement_text: A fit and proper decision shall not be adopted by means of a delegated decision if the relevant supervised entity is the credit institution with the largest total value of assets in a significant supervised group, if this entity is different to that referred to in point (a)

requirements.requirement_text: Risk factors that do not belong to a curve, surface or cube shall be assessed as modellable where specific criteria are met regarding verifiable prices over 12-month observation periods
requirements.deadline_text: 12 months ending at the previous reporting reference date
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2060 of 14 June 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the criteria for assessing the modellability of risk factors under the internal model approach (IMA) and specifying the frequency of that assessment under Article 325be(3) of that Regulation (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The institution has identified for that risk factor the existence of at least 24 prices which are verifiable, have distinct observation dates and are considered representative of that risk factor
requirements.deadline_text: over an observation period of 12 months ending at the previous reporting reference date
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2060 of 14 June 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the criteria for assessing the modellability of risk factors under the internal model approach (IMA) and specifying the frequency of that assessment under Article 325be(3) of that Regulation (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: There has not been a period of 90 days or more in which there were less than four of the verifiable prices
requirements.deadline_text: 90 days period within the 12-month observation period
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2060 of 14 June 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the criteria for assessing the modellability of risk factors under the internal model approach (IMA) and specifying the frequency of that assessment under Article 325be(3) of that Regulation (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The institution has identified for that risk factor the existence of at least 100 prices which are verifiable, have distinct observation dates and are considered representative of that risk factor
requirements.deadline_text: over the observation period of 12 months
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2060 of 14 June 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards specifying the criteria for assessing the modellability of risk factors under the internal model approach (IMA) and specifying the frequency of that assessment under Article 325be(3) of that Regulation (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The institution applies that shifted period consistently across all risk factors of the same type as the risk factor concerned

requirements.requirement_text: A price shall not be considered verifiable where it is obtained from transactions or quotations between two entities of the same group

requirements.requirement_text: A price shall not be considered verifiable where it is of negligible volume compared to usual volume reflective of current market conditions

requirements.requirement_text: A price shall not be considered verifiable where it is obtained from quotations committed with the sole purpose of identifying sufficient verifiable prices

requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The risk control unit shall implement adequate controls and perform quality and validation tests for any outsourced solution
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Full documentation on controls and tests shall be available in all cases for outsourced solutions
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall assess tools and IT solutions obtained from third party vendors in a manner similar to internally developed solutions
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Institutions shall perform internal validation of the model at least annually
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Annual validation shall focus on at least the main issues detected in previous validations or audit reviews, and on changes or new methodologies introduced in the alternative internal model
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Institutions shall have formal approval processes for new financial instruments and products and their introduction in the trading area
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1085 of 13 March 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the assessment methodology under which competent authorities verify an institution’s compliance with the requirements to use internal models for market risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities must permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA) based on the institutions' own operational risk measurement systems where they meet all of the qualitative and quantitative standards, implying compliance of institutions with these requirements at all times.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/959 of 14 March 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards of the specification of the assessment methodology under which competent authorities permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches for operational risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities are required to assess compliance where an institution first applies to use AMA, where an institution applies to extend the AMA in accordance with the approved sequential implementation plan, where an institution applies to extend or change the AMA it has been granted permission to use, and where an institution applies to return to the use of less sophisticated approaches.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/959 of 14 March 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards of the specification of the assessment methodology under which competent authorities permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches for operational risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Institutions are required to articulate what constitutes operational risk for the purposes of implementing policies and processes to evaluate and manage the exposure to operational risk.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/959 of 14 March 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards of the specification of the assessment methodology under which competent authorities permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches for operational risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: An institution's internal operational risk measurement system has to be closely integrated into its day-to-day risk management processes.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/959 of 14 March 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards of the specification of the assessment methodology under which competent authorities permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches for operational risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: An institution's data flows and processes associated with the AMA measurement system are required to be transparent and accessible.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/959 of 14 March 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards of the specification of the assessment methodology under which competent authorities permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches for operational risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The AMA framework of an institution is subject to internal validation and audit reviews in accordance with points (e) and (f).
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/959 of 14 March 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards of the specification of the assessment methodology under which competent authorities permit institutions to use Advanced Measurement Approaches for operational risk (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The most relevant Union currencies shall be identified on the basis of the relative share of each currency in the CCP's average end-of-day open positions across all financial instruments cleared by the CCP, calculated over a period of one year.
requirements.deadline_text: calculated over a period of one year
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The most relevant Union currencies shall be the three currencies with the highest relative share calculated in accordance with paragraph 1, provided that each individual share exceeds 10 %.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The calculation of the relative share of the currencies shall be calculated on an annual basis.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: After assessing that an application is complete as referred to in Article 17(3) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012, the CCP's competent authority shall circulate a proposal for the written agreement under Article 18(5) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 to the members of the college determined in accordance with Article 18(2) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: That written agreement shall include a process for annual review.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: It shall also include an amendment process whereby changes may be initiated at any time by the CCP's competent authority or by other members of the college, subject to approval by the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where the members of the college referred to in paragraph 1 do not express any comments within 10 calendar days, the CCP's competent authority shall proceed with the adoption of the written agreement by the college and with the establishment of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where the members of the college express comments regarding the proposal for the written agreement circulated pursuant to paragraph 1, they shall submit those comments together with a thorough explanation to the CCP's competent authority within 10 calendar days.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: If relevant, the CCP's competent authority shall prepare a revised proposal and convene a meeting to agree on the final written agreement.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where a request for information is made to a college by a competent authority of a Member State which is not a member of the college, the CCP's competent authority, after having consulted the college, shall decide on the most appropriate way to provide and request information to and from the authorities that are not members of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Each member of the college shall designate one participant to attend the meetings of the college and may designate one alternate.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where the central bank of issue of one of the most relevant Union currencies corresponds to more than one central bank, the relevant central banks shall determine the single representative who will participate in the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where in accordance with this Article there is more than one participant from a college member, or there are more college members belonging to the same Member State than number of votes that can be exercised, that college member or those college members shall inform the college which participants shall exercise voting rights.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall ensure that the work of the college facilitates the tasks to be performed in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The college shall notify ESMA of any tasks that the college performs in accordance with paragraph 1.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: ESMA shall have a coordination role in monitoring the tasks performed by a college and shall ensure that its objectives are in line with those of other colleges as far as possible.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority, shall at least ensure that: (a) the objectives of any meeting or activity of the college are clearly identified; (b) the college meetings or activities remain effective, while ensuring that all college members are fully informed of the college activities that are relevant to them; (c) the timetable for meetings or activities of the college is defined so that their outcome provides assistance to the supervision of the CCP; (d) the CCP and other key stakeholders have a clear understanding of the role and functioning of the college; (e) the activities of the college are regularly reviewed and remedial action is taken if the college is not operating effectively; (f) the agenda is set for an annual crisis management planning meeting amongst members of the college in cooperation with the CCP if necessary.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall act as a central point of contact for any matter related to the practical organisation of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall at least perform the following tasks: (a) draw-up, update and circulate the contact list of college members; (b) circulate the agenda as well as documentation for meetings or activities of the college; (c) record minutes of the meetings and formalise action points; (d) manage the college website or other electronic information-sharing mechanism, if any; (e) where practical, provide information and specialised teams where appropriate, to assist the college in its tasks; (f) share information in an appropriate manner among members of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The frequency of college meetings shall be determined by the CCP's competent authority having regard to the CCP's size, nature, scale and complexity, the systemic implications of the CCP across jurisdictions and currencies, the potential impacts of the activities of the CCP, external circumstances and potential requests by college members.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: There shall be at least an annual meeting of the college and if deemed necessary by the CCP's competent authority, a meeting each time that a decision needs to be taken under Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall organise, periodically, meetings between members of the college and the senior management of the CCP.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)
